findings.title: The ⭐ "the Strike leg never breaches the margin-call LTV at the stressed price" makes no assertion at all: its fixture repays Strike in month 1, so its filter skips all 241 rows.
findings.evidence: Probe 1 (assertion census): a throwaway setup file `beforeEach(() => expect.hasAssertions())` in a merged config, run through the slot over 132 test files / 2,458 tests (`npx vitest run -c a6-probe/vitest.assert.config.ts <94 files>` and a second batch of 38). 2,457 pass; the only failure is `src/simulation/__tests__/cyclingSim.test.ts | runCyclingSim — guards cold-storage sweep (coldStoreBufferPct) ⭐ the Strike leg never breaches the margin-call LTV at the stressed price | Error: expected any number of assertion, but got none`. Probe 2 (census of its rows): the test's fixture rebuilt verbatim (LIVE L40–54, run L57, geo/RISING L676–678, buffer 30) prints {"rows":241,"kept":0,"skippedBy":{"m0":1,"postLiq":0,"zeroStrike":240},"liqMonth":null,"first6":[[0,13000,"1.0000",false],[1,0,"1.0000",false],[2,0,…]],"maxStrikeBalance":13000}. The filter at L837 `if (x.m === 0 || x.postLiquidation || x.strikeBalance <= 0) continue;` skips every row — the Strike balance is $13,000 at month 0 and 0 in each of months 1–240 (the census), so the `expect(stressedLtv).toBeLessThanOrEqual(LIVE.strikeMarginLtv + 1e-9)` at L840 never runs. Any engine change to the Strike leg's sweep passes it.
findings.whyItMatters: A ⭐ test whose name promises a Safety invariant (a margin call at Strike is a forced sale) checks it on zero rows — a guard that doesn't guard, and the star tells the next reader it is pinned.
findings.fixSketch: Give the test a fixture that keeps Strike debt after month 0, count the rows it checks, and assert that count is above 0.
findings.notKnownBecause: §9 lists no test-coverage item for the Strike leg's stressed LTV; the §5.1 GAPs are fullyBackedPrice and the accrual clamp.

findings.title: The HELD e2e passes only by retry: its one tap on "Strike Strategy" ~0.3 s after the CDP touch swipe sometimes gets no click from Chromium, and the test neither waits for the swipe to finish nor confirms the tap.
findings.evidence: See `flake`. Base gate e2e.log L99–100: attempt 1 ✘ (7.4s), retry #1 ✓ (3.6s). My run alone (`slot npx playwright test -c <copy, port 5182> e2e/numberFieldSwipe.spec.ts:97 --retries=0`): ✘ at L107 "element(s) not found"; error-context.md shows the Settings MENU still up (button "⚡ Strike Strategy …" present), i.e. the subpage never opened. Trace: tap at (195, 276.67) "performing tap action 17585 → tap action done 17595", then 5 s of "waiting for locator". In-page recording (2 of 10 runs failed): the tap's pointerdown→touchstart→pointerup→touchend on SPAN._settingsRowSubtitle "Budget, BLOC, collat" @195,277 is identical in pass and fail, but in the fails NO mousedown/mouseup/click follows (passes: mousedown +3 ms, click +5 ms). Totals over my runs: 6 of 133 taps that follow the swipe dropped; 0 of ~480 taps not after a swipe; mouse `click()` instead of the tap 9/9.
findings.whyItMatters: A gate e2e that is green only on its retry hides real breaks the same way the sheet-entry race did (build-deploy.md: "a spec that fails in isolation is a bug, not a retry"); when it fails at L107 its last check (L108, no Save left over) never runs.
findings.fixSketch: At L106 re-open the subpage with `click()` (the step tests the held figure, not touch) or end the swipe at rest and assert the subpage (`← Settings`) before reading the field.
findings.notKnownBecause: §9 names only controlDock.spec's LAYOUT 1023 flake; this spec landed in build 2e (c7f709e) and its flake is new.

findings.title: G3 adds timeouts to three sweeps but misses slower ones with no timeout of their own: goalAmount L193 (2.6 s) and cyclingSimPolicy L1412 (1.3 s) outlast placement L108 and crashPlaybookView L569.
findings.evidence: `slot npx vitest run <12 slow-candidate files> --maxWorkers=2 --reporter=json` (Node 22.22.0, busy VM): goalAmount.test.ts:193 "⭐ GOAL ZONE — every month's zone is the price's…" 2,642 ms; supportPolicyView.test.ts:505 2,003 ms; placement.test.ts:108 1,282 ms; cyclingSimPolicy.test.ts:1412 "⭐ the switches — absent ≡ the playbook…" 1,272 ms; cyclingSimPolicy.test.ts:1580 1,000 ms; crashPlaybookView.test.ts:569 977 ms. Same files on Node 26.12.0 (`slot /opt/node26/bin/node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run …`): goalAmount:193 1,652; supportPolicyView:505 1,563; cyclingSimPolicy:1412 1,236; placement:108 1,102; crashPlaybookView:569 731. Closing lines (paren-matched): goalAmount L193 → L208 `});`, cyclingSimPolicy L1412 → L1438 `});`, L1580 → L1595 `});` — no timeout argument. `grep -n "testTimeout" vite.config.ts` → none (5 s default).
findings.whyItMatters: G3's own criterion (a sweep near vitest's 5 s default with no timeout of its own, on a busy machine) fits goalAmount L193 better than two of its three picks; left out, it is the likeliest next gate timeout.
findings.fixSketch: Add goalAmount.test.ts L193 (closing L208) and cyclingSimPolicy.test.ts L1412 (L1438) to G3's `{ timeout: 60_000 }` list — goalAmount.test.ts is build 2/2b's file, so it is the owner's call against G3's "none of build 2b's" note.
findings.notKnownBecause: §8 G3 names only placement L108, supportPolicyView L505 and crashPlaybookView L569.

findings.title: The exp∘log canary is the one test in 1,830 that fails when approximated Math moves by one ulp: an exact `toBe` on `Math.exp(Math.log(CYCLE_LOW_MULT))`, the shape general.md's first row gives a tolerance.
findings.evidence: Probe: a throwaway setup file replaced Math.pow/exp/log/log10/log2/log1p/expm1/cbrt with versions returning the result 1 ulp up whenever it is finite and non-integer (control test: Math.pow(1.1,2) changed, Math.pow(2,3) still 8), merged into vite.config via mergeConfig, run through the slot over the 61 test files that import a Math-using engine module plus 20 store/view files that reach one: 1,830 tests, 1 failure — `cyclePath.test.ts | cycleMultAt 3 · returns exactly CYCLE_TOP_MULT at a high and CYCLE_LOW_MULT at a low | AssertionError: expected 0.3620689655172415 to be 0.3620689655172414 … cyclePath.test.ts:68:48`. L68 is `expect(Math.exp(Math.log(CYCLE_LOW_MULT))).toBe(CYCLE_LOW_MULT);`. The production path is already immune: cyclePath.ts:105 returns `multOf(b.kind)` on an exact turn hit, and the L64 loop over every turn passed under the same perturbation. The comment at L63–67 says no test can tell the shortcut apart; with Math.exp perturbed (vi.spyOn), the L64 loop would fail without the shortcut (at a turn t = 0, so the fallback is exp(log(mult))).
findings.whyItMatters: On a runtime whose exp∘log does not round-trip that constant, the gate goes red for no app change — the G1 incident general.md records (Node 22 CI vs Node 26) — while the shortcut it watches already holds.
findings.fixSketch: Pin the shortcut directly (spy Math.exp to return 1 ulp off; cycleMultAt at every turn still equals multOf(kind)) and retire the two exact canary lines.
findings.notKnownBecause: §9 has no item for it; the G1 golden (cyclingSimPolicy L113–138) already stores its paths, and this canary is outside it.

findings.title: No unit test names 68 of the 117 component files (not 74), and the riskiest of them carry sentences a wiring test could pin, starting with the at-rest copy general.md says once shipped false.
findings.evidence: Count: for each of the 117 `src/components/**/*.tsx` (outside __tests__), `grep -lE "<Name>\.tsx|/<Name>['\"]"` over the 190 test files → 68 unnamed (all 122 .tsx in src: 72; counting a bare mention, comments included: 56; 6 of the 68 appear in an e2e spec). Pinnable lines with no test: NostrAuthGate.tsx:693–696 "The app keeps your key protected on this device, but that's not a backup…" (general.md: the import notice once claimed "all your encrypted data is permanently unrecoverable"; `grep -rnE "at rest|encrypted data|not a backup"` over the tests → no guard); StoreMigrationGate.tsx:60 "Encrypt your local data"; RecoveryKeyCeremony.tsx:436 "Backed up. Your plan now syncs, encrypted, under your key."; BackupNagCard.tsx (the backup ladder's words); LiquidationModeler.tsx:29 and :53 (an inline drop % in a seizure sentence) and :139 "CB_LIF = … (Morpho formula at 86% LLTV)"; OwnershipBar.tsx:37–40 and VenueBar.tsx (the viewer's figures, `btc * btcPrice` inline); MonthBreakdown.tsx (8 inline formats); SharingPage.tsx / ViewerSettings.tsx (viewer-access sentences).
findings.whyItMatters: With no render harness, a sentence in an unread component is pinned by nothing; the at-rest copy is a security promise the rules forbid making falsely, and its earlier false version was found only by reading.
findings.fixSketch: One source-reading test: grep src/components for at-rest claims about plan data ("data is encrypted", "encrypted data", "stored encrypted") and pin NostrAuthGate's "not a backup" line.
findings.notKnownBecause: §9 lists no test-coverage item for these components; the spec's own count (74) is a premise, not a queued item.

findings.title: The assertion labelled "KEPT non-vacuous on both sides" cannot fail: `expect.any(Number)` accepts a zero count.
findings.evidence: L301: `expect([runKept, baseKept], 'KEPT non-vacuous on both sides').toEqual([expect.any(Number), expect.any(Number)]);` where both are counters initialised to 0 at L288. Probe: a throwaway test with `const runKept = 0, baseKept = 0;` and that exact line → `Tests 1 passed (1)`. The real non-vacuity check is the next line, L302 `expect(Math.min(runKept, baseKept)).toBeGreaterThan(5)`.
findings.whyItMatters: A line that says it proves non-vacuity and proves nothing; harmless only because L302 follows it.
findings.fixSketch: Delete L301 (L302 is the check) or make it `toBeGreaterThan(0)` on each side.

Under a 1-ulp perturbation of every approximated Math function, 1,829 of 1,830 tests in 81 files pass (only the cyclePath canary, A6-4): no other exact golden rests on Math.pow/exp/log. No `**` operator anywhere in src (grep).

flake.rootCause: A test race in numberFieldSwipe.spec.ts HELD (L97). After the CDP touch swipe (touchSwipeBack L48–57: 12 moves, 8 ms waits, released at speed) the test waits only for the menu row to be visible (L104). That holds as soon as EdgeBackGesture's 200 ms exit timer runs onBack() (EdgeBackGesture.tsx:108 → SettingsMain.tsx:285 setSettingsPage('menu')). It then taps the row once (L106), about 315–350 ms after the swipe's release, and reads the field (L107). Playwright's tap() resolves once its touchStart/touchEnd are sent; nothing checks that a click followed. In the failing runs Chromium's emulated touch makes no click from that tap: pointerdown, touchstart, pointerup and touchend reach the row as usual, but no mousedown, mouseup or click comes after them. SettingsRow's onClick (SettingsMain.tsx:482) never runs, the menu stays up, and the field is "not found". This is not an app defect: every click that arrives opens the page and shows 20000, and click() in place of the tap passed 9 of 9. Machine load changes how often it happens: 3 of 3 for the session; for me, 6 of 23 post-swipe taps in busy stretches (1/1, 1/3, 2/9, 2/10) and 0 of 110 in quiet ones; the retry, slowed by tracing, passed. I could not confirm the exact Chromium mechanism (tap suppression by the swipe's fling): a release held still for 300 ms and a release at speed both passed 22 of 22 in the same quiet window.
flake.evidence: Base: /tmp/hardening-1/base-gate/e2e.log L99 "✘ 92 … HELD … (7.4s)", L100 "✓ 93 … (retry #1) (3.6s)", L155 "1 flaky". Mine: `slot npx playwright test -c <playwright.config copy on 5182, retries 0> e2e/numberFieldSwipe.spec.ts:97 --retries=0` → "1 failed … expect(locator).toHaveValue(expected) failed … Expected: \"20000\" … element(s) not found"; error-context.md snapshot = the Settings menu (button "⚡ Strike Strategy Budget, BLOC, collateral, start date, cold storage ›" etc.). Trace 0-trace.trace: call@94 tap "locator resolved to <div tabindex=0 role=button class=_settingsRow…>", "performing tap action" 17585.4, "tap action done" 17595.0; input point {x:195,y:276.67} (the menu reopened scrolled: body scrollTop 522 on the subpage, clamped to 312 on the menu, so the row is at y≈277, not 589); call@96 then "waiting for locator" until the 5 s timeout. In-page recorder (passive capture listeners pushing to a window array, read at the end), 10 repeats: 2 FAIL. FAIL: "4349 pointerdown SPAN._settingsRowSubtitle… pid=6P @195,277 | 4349 touchstart … touches=1 | 4350 gotpointercapture | 4350 pointerup | 4350 lostpointercapture | 4350 touchend touches=0" and nothing after. PASS: the same six, then "8626 mousedown … 8628 mouseup … 8628 click …". Controls: 25 taps with no swipe before them (21 after a programmatic scroll, 4 after the ← Settings button) 25/25; the taps before the swipe in every test ~460/460; click() instead of the tap 9/9; a 1 s wait (1/1), a 600 ms wait (4/4) and a wait for the edge page's computed transform and the body scroll to hold still across two frames (8/8) all passed, but only in a quiet window, so none is proven a fix. The original test with --repeat-each=5 in a quiet window: 5/5 passed.
